# Hyperfabric Evolution — repository-wide Copilot context

This is an independently public research repository. **Read the root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)** for the current project map, exact offline test commands, cross-agent handoff, publication classes, and noncollision rules. The public [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [PUBLICATION_POLICY.md](../PUBLICATION_POLICY.md) govern submissions.

Before editing, inspect current `main`, open issues/PRs, and overlapping paths. Propose one small, independently useful public change with explicit acceptance and negative tests. Work on an isolated branch, recheck the full diff and source rights, and submit through PR review; never push directly to protected `main`. Report missing CI or execution access rather than guessing.

Keep synthetic evidence, provider-reported live XRPL observations, future research, and actual deployed functionality separate. Never import nonpublic project source, protected architecture, personal data, signing keys, wallet activity, unlicensed dependencies, or sensitive disclosure content. Do not invent contributor acceptance, independent consensus verification, runtime authority, or release status.

For demonstrations, favor genuine inspectable interaction and explainable failure cases over fabricated status counts or empty visual spectacle. Human contributors control GitHub write approval and publication.
